requirements.title: C_FUNLOC argument restrictions
requirements.definition: X is a procedure; a procedure pointer X is associated, and X is not a coindexed object.

pending.C_FUNLOC-X-procedure: Positive source control passes a BIND(C) module function as X and pairs C_NULL_FUNPTR, a non-null C_FUNLOC result, same target, and distinct target observations; mutation passes a data object and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_FUNLOC-X-procedure-pointer-associated: Positive source control pointer-assigns PROCEDURE(iface), POINTER :: proc => add_sentinel before C_FUNLOC(proc); mutation NULLIFYs proc before the reference and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.C_FUNLOC-X-not-coindexed: OUT OF SCOPE: a coindexed procedure target requires coarray/image coverage, excluded by suite policy; source inventory records the restriction without a runtime fixture.

requirements.title: C_FUNLOC returns a scalar C_FUNPTR
requirements.definition: The C_FUNLOC result is a scalar of type C_FUNPTR.

pending.C_FUNLOC-result-c-funptr-scalar: Assign C_FUNLOC(add_sentinel) to TYPE(C_FUNPTR) :: raw initialized to C_NULL_FUNPTR, assert RANK(raw)==0, assert C_ASSOCIATED(C_NULL_FUNPTR) is false, assert C_ASSOCIATED(raw) is true, and distinguish same-target versus distinct-target procedure pointers by calls after C_F_PROCPOINTER; mutation uses C_LOC on data and fails the declared type control.

requirements.title: C_FUNLOC models a procedure pointer assignment to X
requirements.definition: The C_FUNLOC result is determined as though a C_FUNPTR derived object contained a procedure pointer component pointer-assigned to X.

pending.C_FUNLOC-result-denotes-X-target: Guarded Fortran-only plan first requires C_INT > 0; raw=C_FUNLOC(add_sentinel), C_F_PROCPOINTER(raw,fp), call fp(40_C_INT), and expect 57_C_INT; a second procedure returning -57_C_INT proves the target identity is load-bearing.
pending.C_FUNLOC-procedure-pointer-actual-denote: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0; pointer-assign proc=>add_sentinel before raw=C_FUNLOC(proc), convert with C_F_PROCPOINTER, and expect proc target result 57_C_INT; companion proc=>other_sentinel expects -57_C_INT.

requirements.title: C_FUNLOC round trip through C_F_PROCPOINTER has pointer-assignment effect
requirements.definition: A C_FUNLOC result used as CPTR in C_F_PROCPOINTER has the effect of the procedure pointer assignment FPTR => X, provided FPTR attributes allow that pointer assignment.

pending.C_FUNLOC-C_F_PROCPOINTER-roundtrip-assoc: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0; define abstract interface integer(C_INT) function iface(i) BIND(C); convert raw=C_FUNLOC(add_sentinel) through C_F_PROCPOINTER(raw,fp); assert ASSOCIATED(fp) and fp(25_C_INT)==42_C_INT with fp initially NULL().
pending.C_FUNLOC-C_F_PROCPOINTER-roundtrip-chara: Guarded plan first requires C_INT > 0 and uses a compatible FPTR interface with one VALUE integer(C_INT) dummy and integer(C_INT) result; source mutation changes only the dummy VALUE attribute in the FPTR interface and claims no diagnostic facet, isolating the attribute premise.
